answer_1.quote: We introduce a theoretically‑grounded taxonomy of fine‑grained categories of replies to hate speech.

answer_2.quote: We report F1 scores for classification; no automatic metrics are used to evaluate generated outputs.

answer_3.quote: All of our models are neural classifiers with the RoBERTa transformer as the main component.

answer_4.quote: The paper does not conduct human evaluations of generated outputs.
